notes.note: Gulden was massive with 47 disposals and 9 clearances. This makes it 4 over 130 in a row now for him but there is a risk that given his injuries he may get some form of rest this week.
Gulden was the best for the Swans as he continues his impressive return to footy with his 39 touches and goal.
Errol has now had back to back 140+ scores and those that brought him in as a Holmes replacement would be very happy with it.  24 disposals at 85% and a goal for the Sydney star.
Gulden again showed that he is back to his very best as he posted 41 disposals and had 7 clearances to top score in the game. He will be a popular option for anyone needing a midfield replacement.
Errol finished up with 22 disposals at 81% as he continues to get back up to speed playing 81% time on ground this week.
30 disposals for Gulden with 11 contested as he was the best scorer for the Swans on the night. He is looking like he is back to his best.
Gulden had the 27 disposals but his disposal efficiency was down. He continues to get cheaper but unless his scoring rises soon he isn't one that you want to bring in just yet.

Gulden returned after the long lay off since round 1. He played 77% time on ground and had 18 disposals but just 44% efficiency. Certainly one to watch but maybe just hold off another week as he has a BE of 151
Gulden looks set to be returning following the bye according to coach Dean Cox.
Gulden was having a great game before he injured his shoulder in the last term. He is going to miss for 4 months so a must trade.
Gulden was at the top of a lot of shopping lists and this just cemented that. He was the one that really got the Swans going after half time.
